major_cooldowns.name: Thunder Focus Tea
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it before you need the empowerment and spend it on Renewing Mist for the duration extension most of the time, or on Enveloping Mist when a target needs a big instant heal, or on Rising Sun Kick to cut its cooldown when you need the extra damage or Versatility.

major_cooldowns.name: Invoke Yu'lon, the Jade Serpent
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Spend your Renewing Mist charges before you pop it, then chain 3-4 Enveloping Mists across the raid, weave Rising Sun Kick every time it comes off cooldown, and fill the rest with Vivify.

major_cooldowns.name: Invoke Chi-Ji, the Red Crane
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Open with Blackout Kick to spend the Teachings of the Monastery stacks it grants, ideally hitting multiple targets, then weave in Enveloping Mist ahead of incoming damage before extending it with Rising Mist.

major_cooldowns.name: Life Cocoon
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Drop it on whoever is about to die; it absorbs damage for 12 seconds, boosts the healing-over-time they receive by 50%, and will not break your Soothing Mist channel if cast on the same target.

major_cooldowns.name: Revival
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it for the raid-wide heal, saving it for a damage spike that also lets you strip 3 Magic, Disease, or Poison effects from the raid.

major_cooldowns.name: Restoral
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Take this instead of Revival when the fight makes the Magic dispel dangerous; it heals the same amount, skips the dispel, and can be cast while stunned.

rule.description: Spend Thunder Focus Tea before it expires
rule.action: Cast Renewing Mist, Rising Sun Kick, or Enveloping Mist within its window, favoring Renewing Mist most of the time and Enveloping Mist when a target needs the burst heal.

rule.description: Maintain Renewing Mist across the raid
rule.action: Refresh Renewing Mist proactively across the raid so its uptime never fully lapses.
Switch to Spinning Crane Kick as your main filler once 5 or more enemies are stacked together.

rule.description: Open Invoke Chi-Ji with Blackout Kick
rule.action: Follow Invoke Chi-Ji, the Red Crane immediately with Blackout Kick to spend the Teachings of the Monastery stacks it grants, ideally hitting multiple targets.
